name: Morning Sencha
description: A bright, grassy Japanese green tea steamed to lock in its sweetness. Our everyday cup for slow mornings.

name: Assam Breakfast
description: Bold, malty Assam leaves that stand up beautifully to milk. A sturdy start to any day.

name: Tieguanyin Iron Goddess
description: A rolled Fujian oolong with orchid aromatics and a creamy finish. Rewards many short infusions.

name: Chamomile Honey
description: Whole Egyptian chamomile flowers blended with a hint of honeybush. Caffeine-free and made for winding down.

name: Cast Iron Teapot
description: A hand-finished 900 ml tetsubin with an enamel interior and stainless infuser. Holds heat for a long, lazy pour.

name: Jasmine Pearls
description: Hand-rolled green tea pearls scented with fresh jasmine blossoms over several nights. Watch them unfurl in the cup.

name: Earl Grey Lavender
description: Ceylon black tea with cold-pressed bergamot and a soft touch of French lavender. A classic, gently reimagined.

name: Milk Oolong
description: A Taiwanese Jin Xuan oolong with a naturally buttery, silky texture. No milk added, just remarkable leaves.

name: Peppermint Leaf
description: Cool, crisp whole-leaf peppermint grown in Oregon's Willamette Valley. Lovely hot or poured over ice.

name: Glass Infuser Mug
description: A 400 ml double-walled borosilicate mug with a removable fine-mesh infuser. Brew and sip from one vessel.

name: Ceremonial Matcha
description: Stone-ground first-harvest matcha from Uji with a vivid color and smooth umami. Whisk it straight or into a latte.

name: Smoky Lapsang
description: Black tea leaves slowly dried over pinewood fires. Campfire-smoky, rich, and unforgettable.

name: Oriental Beauty
description: A heavily oxidized oolong with natural notes of honey and ripe peach. One of Taiwan's most celebrated teas.

name: Rooibos Vanilla
description: South African red rooibos blended with Madagascar vanilla bean. Naturally sweet and caffeine-free.

name: Ceramic Tasting Cups
description: A set of four glazed stoneware cups sized for gongfu-style tasting. Each one is thrown by hand, so no two are alike.
